candidate_relations.scope_detail: Discoid lupus erythematosus is a chronic inflammatory skin condition, often presenting with scarring plaques, typically on sun-exposed areas.

candidate_relations.scope_detail: Dermatitis is a general term for skin inflammation.

candidate_relations.scope_detail: Cellulitis is a bacterial infection of the deeper layers of the skin.

candidate_relations.scope_detail: Erythema multiforme is an acute, self-limited, inflammatory skin reaction, often triggered by infections or drugs.

candidate_relations.reason: Atopic dermatitis typically presents with pruritic, erythematous, scaly patches and plaques, often with lichenification. candidate_relations.scope_detail: Atopic dermatitis is a chronic inflammatory skin condition characterized by eczema.
